description:
Manage buffer.md, the staging queue that `flush` turns into daily logs and tasks.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date D] — append an UNKNOWN raw capture (blocks flush; avoid)
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date D] — append a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date D] — append a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due D] [--scheduled D] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] [--date D] — append an ACTION (same as `tasks add`)
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup by thread and date, and validate
  flush — tend, then write each thread's daily log, clear the buffer and ingest the flushed ACTIONs into tasks

Args:
  THREAD: thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink.
  TEXT (add-action): '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'.
  TARGET: Kind/Name, Kind/Name/hours, Kind/Name/payments, Kind/Name/logs/YYYY-MM-DD, a note stem, or people/<Name>.
  SUMMARY: optional words shown after the link.
  FILTER: case-insensitive text to match.
  LINE_NUMBER: integer from `buffer list`.

Flags:
  top level (before the subcommand):
    --quiet   suppress info output
  add, add-text, add-ref, add-action:
    --date YYYY-MM-DD   file under the day the thing happened (default today)
  add-action:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD, --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8   8-char task uuid from `tasks list`; repeatable
  list:
    --json   JSON output

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/SGB", "Validated the SQL detection patterns; join semantics still unresolved."]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/SGB", "2026-09-10-14-30-00", "kickoff meeting"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-10-09", "--priority", "H"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Do not use `add`. UNKNOWN entries fail tend and block flush until removed with rm and re-added with add-text, add-ref or add-action.
  Logs are written to threads/<Kind>/<Name>/logs/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md. flush ingests the ACTIONs itself; do not run `tasks` afterwards. An ACTION that is already an open task is skipped as 'already a task'; a duplicate within the buffer is skipped as 'already buffered'.
  tend and flush rewrite buffer.md in place. Do not edit buffer.md by hand.
  Line numbers can change after rm or tend. Run list again before each rm.
  Exit 1: line number not an integer, out of range or empty, or validation failed during tend or flush.
